title: Herbal Bisque Soup
description: A creamy, gluten-free soup made with herbal flavors and a touch of nutmeg. Enjoy as a comforting snack or light meal.
instructions: Heat the chicken broth in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the brewed herbal tea to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the chopped nut and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Return the pot to the stovetop and add the cream and bisque. Stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with a sprinkle of nutmeg if desired.
